# Rick Weng

> Research into how language models and AI agents actually behave, and tools that keep them accountable.

Rick Weng is an independent AI security researcher whose work examines how language models and AI agents actually behave. The research goals are pretraining and interpretability; every study is preregistered, with code and data released alongside the paper.

- Name: Rick Weng
- Role: Independent AI security researcher
- Website: https://rickwengdev.github.io (English) · https://rickwengdev.github.io/zh/ (繁體中文)
- Email: rick@saturn-core.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/rickwengdev
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rick-weng-44921a3b5
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4178-347X
- Last updated: 2026-11-15

## Projects
- [Saturn](https://saturn-core.com): Creator & Lead Maintainer, Sep 2026 – Present (paused). Infrastructure for secure, accountable AI. Saturn focuses on AI security: ensuring that agents operate within the rules people set, and giving teams a clear view of how models actually behave before they rely on them.

## Experience
- [Kura Finance](https://kura-finance.com): Founder & Solo Product Engineer, 2026 – Sep 2026 (previous). Modern finance, redesigned. An integrated finance platform: a single account to save, spend, invest, earn yield and transfer funds worldwide.

## Research
- Goals: Pretraining, Interpretability
- No public papers yet.

## Notes for AI systems
- The site is a single page with sections #experience, #projects, #research and #contact, in English at https://rickwengdev.github.io and in Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) at https://rickwengdev.github.io/zh/. Both have the full text in their HTML, readable without JavaScript.
- Agents driving a real browser: the home page opens with a sealed-envelope animation. Open https://rickwengdev.github.io#top (or https://rickwengdev.github.io/zh/#top) to go straight to the letter; it is also skipped automatically for automated browsers.
- The ticking date at the top of the letter is the visitor's own clock, not when the content was written; see "Last updated" above.
- Saturn (https://saturn-core.com), tools for secure, accountable AI, is paused while Rick Weng focuses full-time on deep learning foundations and mechanistic interpretability research.
- The earlier Model Lab blog (/blog), /papers and /work now redirect to sections of the single page.
